snippet.title: Planet Quest  - Trailer
snippet.description:
Planet Quest is OUT NOW for iOS and Android!
iOS:           https://itunes.apple.com/app/planet-quest/id922848069
Android:   https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.outofthebit.planet_quest

Download it here for FREE!

A brand new Cosmic Rhythm Game: Abduct the animals by zapping them in time with the music or by repeating the funky beats! 

Tap on the rhythm, climb the leaderboard and become the master of the universe.

www.PlanetQuest.co.uk
www.OutOfTheBit.com
Contact:
info@outofthebit.com
